about.title: About {name}
about.p1: {name} helps Bangladeshi students find countries, universities, programs and scholarships abroad, check whether they are eligible, and choose for themselves.
about.p2: It is a guidance tool only. Admission, visas, finances and choosing an agency stay with you.
about.p3: We have no deals with agencies. Every program shows its official link and the date we last checked it.
about.p4: This is a private preview. Everything in it is sample data: the universities, programs, numbers and dates are invented.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.p1: {name} gives guidance only. We don't guarantee admission, a scholarship or a visa.
disclaimer.p2: Requirements, deadlines, fees and rules change. Always confirm on the official university page and with the embassy before you decide or pay.
disclaimer.p3: The Fit Score compares your profile with published requirements. It is not a chance of admission.
disclaimer.p4: Rankings are shown with their source and year only. Job links go to outside job sites; we don't copy their listings.
disclaimer.p5: In this preview all data is sample data and must not be used for real decisions.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: There's no login, no cookies, no analytics, no tracking pixels and no session replay.
privacy.p2: Your profile, saved programs and settings stay in this browser's local storage. Nothing is sent to us or anyone else.
privacy.p3: Forms check your answers but don't send them in this preview.
privacy.howToDelete: Delete your profile on the My profile page, or clear this site's data in your browser settings to remove everything.
